{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: 32 Blades Steel Feeler Gauge Dual Marked Metric and Imperial Measuring Tool; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do practical repairs, but I have no current need to measure precise gaps.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: J-B Weld ClearWeld 5 Minute Epoxy, Clear, Syringe, 2 Pack, 50112-2; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for small repairs needing a rigid bond, complementing the tape and vinyl cement I have used.
